newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in consolidation.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed in what traders said was a consolidation after Monday's sharp drop in prices.
"This was a typical consolidation after a down day. We were slightly lower and slightly higher all day, and the market really lacked conviction to break out either way," an MGE trader said.

The market drew continued pressure Tuesday amid forecasts for more rains this week in growing areas of North Dakota, which should help ease the drought conditions that have underpinned MGE spring wheat for the last three weeks.
MGE spring wheat settled 1/2 cent per bushel lower to 1-1/4 cents higher, with July up 1-1/4 cents at $3.84-3/4. New crop September was unchanged at $3.74-1/2.
Volume in spring wheat futures was relatively light and was estimated at 19.3 million bushels, down from Monday's volume of nearly 25 million bushels.
